audit.method: Direct model translation followed by a complete source-target editorial reading of the Community Center introduction and Linus’s nighttime foraging confrontation with every embedded dialogue response. Every spoken line, internal message, player response, civic and Joja term, food-waste argument, property argument, survival statement, and food offer was reviewed in full event context against the canonical Ukrainian glossary. Event commands, actors, movement, timing, quest and mail state, nested $y response delimiters, placeholders, gender branches, dialogue markers, music and sound IDs, and all non-text payloads were preserved and structurally compared with English. Remaining Town records and full-locale final audits remain pending.
